name: sand-arm-roof
notes: Roof geometry: bedrock ABOVE at [0,3,0]; piston [0,2,0] faces DOWN (head into air at [0,1,0]), powered by dust at [1,2,0]. A sand block falls onto that dust: FallingBlockEntity lands in the ENTITY phase (7), after the tick's block-event phase, so the retract event it queues survives to the NEXT tick's block events. The chord is the ONE key press a player makes with attack+use on the same key: break the piston, place a piston facing UP (toward the bedrock).
